passages.text: Las entradas para la catedral se compran en la taquilla de enfrente, no aquí. Los miércoles por la tarde es gratis para los residentes, pero para los turistas cuesta doce euros, con la audioguía incluida.
passages.en: Tickets for the cathedral are bought at the ticket office opposite, not here. On Wednesday afternoons it's free for residents, but for tourists it costs twelve euros, audio guide included.
passages.question: Which is true for you as a tourist?
passages.answer: Buy tickets at the office opposite. Twelve euros, audio guide included.
wrong: It is free for everyone on Wednesday afternoon.
Buy your ticket here at this counter.

passages.text: Para o Palácio da Pena, o melhor é apanhar o autocarro 434 aqui à frente da estação. Os bilhetes compram-se online ou na entrada, mas ao fim de semana há muita fila, por isso convém ir cedo.
passages.en: For Pena Palace, it's best to catch the 434 bus here in front of the station. Tickets are bought online or at the entrance, but at weekends there's a long queue, so it's best to go early.
passages.question: What is the advice?
passages.answer: Take bus 434 from outside the station, and go early at the weekend.
wrong: Walk up, because no buses go there.
Tickets are only sold at the train station.
Weekends are quiet, so go then.

passages.text: La visita guiada sale de la plaza a las once y a las cuatro, y dura dos horas. Se recorre todo el casco antiguo, pero hay muchas cuestas, así que lleve calzado cómodo.
passages.en: The guided tour leaves from the square at eleven and at four and lasts two hours. It covers the whole old town, but there are lots of slopes, so wear comfortable shoes.
passages.question: What's the advice for the tour?
passages.answer: Wear comfortable shoes; it's very hilly.
wrong: Come at noon when it's quiet.

passages.text: O bilhete combinado dá para o palácio, o parque e o castelo, e fica mais barato. Do parque ao palácio ainda é uma subida de quinze minutos; há um autocarro pequeno, mas paga-se à parte.
passages.en: The combined ticket covers the palace, the park and the castle, and it's cheaper. From the park to the palace it's still a fifteen-minute climb; there's a small shuttle, but you pay for it separately.
passages.question: What costs extra?
passages.answer: The small shuttle up to the palace.

passages.text: El menú del día cuesta quince euros: de primero, sopa castellana o ensalada; de segundo, perdiz o carcamusas; y postre casero. El pan y una bebida van incluidos.
passages.en: The set menu costs fifteen euros: to start, Castilian soup or salad; for the main, partridge or a meat stew; and a homemade dessert. Bread and a drink are included.
passages.question: What is included?
passages.answer: Three courses, bread and a drink for fifteen euros.
wrong: Only the main course and bread.
Three courses, but drinks are extra.

passages.text: Os travesseiros saem do forno a toda a hora, mas a fila é grande ao fim de semana. Se tiver pressa, leve uma caixa e coma no comboio. As queijadas aguentam bem até ao dia seguinte.
passages.en: Travesseiros come out of the oven all the time, but the queue is long at weekends. If you're in a hurry, take a box and eat them on the train. The queijadas keep well until the next day.
passages.question: What's the tip if you're in a hurry?
passages.answer: Take a box and eat on the train.
wrong: Skip the queue by paying online.

passages.text: El último tren a Madrid sale a las nueve y veinte. Si lo pierde, hay autobuses cada media hora hasta las diez desde la estación de autobuses, que está al otro lado del río.
passages.en: The last train to Madrid leaves at nine twenty. If you miss it, there are buses every half hour until ten from the bus station, which is on the other side of the river.
passages.question: What's the backup plan?
passages.answer: Buses every half hour until ten, across the river.

passages.text: Se quiser ver o pôr do sol, apanhe o autocarro para o Cabo da Roca e depois siga para Cascais; de lá há comboios para Lisboa até depois da meia-noite. É mais longo, mas vale a pena.
passages.en: If you want to see the sunset, take the bus to Cabo da Roca and then carry on to Cascais; from there trains run to Lisbon until after midnight. It's longer, but worth it.
passages.question: What's the suggested route back?
passages.answer: Cabo da Roca for the sunset, then Cascais and the train.
wrong: Straight back by train from Sintra.
A taxi from Cabo da Roca to Lisbon.
